about: The AI apps Clotr checks outside the browser. Email and chat apps are not on this list. For makers whose every desktop app is an AI app, Clotr matches the maker's signer or Store publisher id; other apps use their executable name plus Store package family or publisher. Android apps use the maker's signing certificate digest with the app package name. Each entry says where it was checked; 'to confirm on a real PC' or 'to confirm on a real phone' means it is not confirmed yet.
